claims.evidence: Witness only saw exterior photos; no evidence of starting, idling, smoke/noise, or test ride.
Witness report does not show any readable brand/model badge or identification marks.
No mechanical/electrical test results were shown (brakes, clutch, lights, engine running, leaks, etc.).

risks.risk: Engine may not start or may have internal issues (worn engine, overheating, bad carb/injection, major noise/smoke).
risks.proof: A short video of the bike starting from cold, idling steadily, and a 5–10 minute ride with no unusual smoke/noise.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used motorcycle with unknown running condition (worst-case: may need repairs).

risks.risk: Hidden accident/frame damage or misalignment not visible from the rear-left exterior angle.
risks.proof: Walk-around video showing straight alignment of wheels/handlebar, plus close-ups of frame/engine mounts and any welds/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially damaged/unknown history (worst-case: frame/repair risk).

risks.risk: Brake, clutch, and drivetrain wear (chain/sprockets, clutch slipping) not confirmed by photos.
risks.proof: Video test: hard brake stop from low speed, clutch engagement test, and chain/sprocket close-ups.
risks.if_unproven: Price as needing inspection/possible replacement of wear items.

risks.risk: Tires may be worn, cracked, or may not hold air; rear tread only appears present but condition is unclear.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of front and rear tire tread depth/sidewalls + demonstration that tires hold air (e.g., pressure check or recent pump receipt).
risks.if_unproven: Price as tires condition unknown (worst-case: tires may need replacement).

risks.risk: Electricals may be faulty (headlight, indicators, horn, brake light), not shown as working.
risks.proof: Video showing ignition on and all lights/indicators/horn working, including brake light during a brake test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as electricals unverified (worst-case: may need repairs).

risks.risk: Fuel tank rust/dents or leaks (oil/fuel) not visible from the provided rear-left exterior view.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of fuel tank, under-seat area, and engine for leaks + wipe test (clean area then show no fresh leaks after running).
risks.if_unproven: Price as leak risk possible (worst-case: may require cleaning/repairs).

risks.risk: Brand/model (seller says Suzuki) may be incorrect; witness cannot confirm identity details.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the tank/side badge, engine number/frame number area, and any model plate readable.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown make/model motorcycle based only on visible features.

proof_requests: Clear photos of brand/model badges (tank/side) and any readable engine/frame numbers or model plate.
Video: cold start + steady idle + short ride (5–10 minutes) showing no smoke and smooth acceleration.
Video test: front and rear brake effectiveness (including brake light) and clutch engagement.
Close-ups of front and rear tires (tread + sidewalls) and confirmation tires hold air.
Video showing headlight, indicators, horn, and all lights working.
Close-ups of fuel tank and engine area for rust/leaks (oil/fuel) plus a wipe-and-check after running.
response.reason: The witness confirms only general exterior appearance; key factors that determine a safe buy-and-drive price (running condition, brakes/clutch, electricals, tires, leaks, and exact make/model) are not shown or verifiable from the report. Request the specific test/close-up proofs before pricing.
